evals.prompt: Sync a clean committed bundle whose destination-only family eval is missing upstream, with SYNC_ALLOW_DIRTY=1.

Does not delete the local eval or bypass the guard with dirty-source approval.
No staging, commit, stash or unrelated checkout changes.

Preserves model-first findings-only manual review and source-timing rules.
No overwrite, allowlist expansion or automatic commit.
